pages.title: Titration Bench
pages.text: A burette, a flask and an indicator: drop by drop until the colour turns, and you know exactly how strong it is.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set how much titrant is added. The pH jumps at the endpoint - stop in the window (pH 4 to 10) and the reagent comes out assayed. Each reagent has its own endpoint (the page shows its strength). An assayed feed keeps the chemical catalysts from being poisoned.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Ammonia, Nitric Acid, Sulfur Dioxide, Sulfuric Acid.
